thread:
harry: quick help — acme POC suddenly getting 401s across a few endpoints after a deploy. They said they pasted a token into their env var.

anita: can you paste the error they sent?

harry: dev forwarded this snippet: 

```\ncurl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_dev_copy_99\" -H \"X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp\" https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{\"error\":\"invalid_token\",\"message\":\"token_org_mismatch: token bound to org 'sandbox-team'\",\"code\":401}
```\n
lee: that looks like someone copied a sandbox/personal token. Also saw one 403 for a websocket/stream attempt: 

```\n{\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\",\"message\":\"missing scope: inference:stream\",\"code\":403}
```\n
infra-bot: metrics (acme-poc): avg_rps 6.0, token_errors 14 (10m), 95p latency 200ms.

anita: root cause: two independent problems that overlapped — wrong-org token + missing stream scope. Remediation: 1) create an org-scoped service token in the Acme console with required scopes. 2) if they need per-project isolation, bind token to the correct project or remove X-Redwood-Project header. 3) avoid pasting long-lived tokens into frontend code.

harry: suggested CLI for them: `rdwctl tokens create --org acme-corp --project acme-web --scopes inference:invoke,inference:stream --name \"poc-svc\"` — gave that to their engineer.

lee: I repro'd locally by swapping to a token bound to another org and got the same token_org_mismatch. Swap to `sk_org_acme_ok` -> all good.

anita: customer asked if switching to org-managed tokens affects pricing/quotas. Short answer: no — pricing/quota follow the billing org, not token type. If they change billing account, that affects tiers.

harry: security wants a one-line audit blurb for their infosec team. Drafted: \"Redwood records token lifecycle events (create, revoke, rotate), creator metadata, scopes, org/project binding, and last-used timestamps; audit logs are available via the console and tokens API. Short-lived SSO tokens and KMS-backed rotation are supported.\"\n

infra-bot: monitoring: starting 15m watch for acme-poc. alerts: none so far.

lee: customer rotated to an org token with both invoke+stream scopes and confirms no more 4xx errors.

anita: action items: harry -> drop steps and rdwctl snippet in the ticket; lee -> send repro snippet to their engineer; infra-bot -> continue 15m watch.

harry: closing loop in CRM as \"auth resolved\". thanks team. :white_check_mark:
